name: Bitchin Beach ~Risei Buttobi! Bukkake Nakadashi Hamehame Ahe Natsu Monogatari~
original_name: びっちンびーち ～理性ぶっ飛び！ぶっかけ中出しハメハメあへ夏物語～
source: On a summer vacation day, four close female high school students arrived at a beach called the Nympho Paradise. Their goal was, of course, to hook up. They were known as carnivorous girls, or even more so, omnivorous girls. Each one had a different type, but they were all lascivious sluts who didn't discriminate based on age. When they appeared on the beach in skimpy swimsuits, they were immediately swarmed by pick-up artists. They changed the location to a bungalow deep in the woods, and a great orgy began.
translation: 暑假的一天，四个关系亲密的女高中生来到了一个叫做“淫女天堂”的海滩。她们的目的当然是约炮。她们被称为肉食女，更确切地说是杂食女。每个人类型不同，但都是不挑年龄的淫荡荡妇。当她们穿着暴露的泳装出现在海滩上时，立刻被搭讪者们团团围住。她们将地点换到了树林深处的平房，一场盛大的乱交派对就此开始。
